## Receptionist 0b: Vapi Assistant
Builds the whole assistant from code and the prompt file: Nora's system prompt, GPT-5.4 mini, the Clara voice, Deepgram nova-3, six function tools pointing at **Receptionist 1** (with the secret header), the end-of-call webhook to **Receptionist 3**, and the post-call summary and structured data.

Creates it the first time, then updates it in place, so re-run it after any prompt change. Also claims a free Vapi number (Austin, 512) once.
